plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: Opinionated feature-development pipeline: brainstorm -> size-branch (wayfinder / grill-with-docs) -> plan -> parallel subagents -> review + verify.

plugins.name: spec-style-d
plugins.description: Feature specs as one canonical fact set rendered twice — a narrative human doc and a contract-first AI doc — with hand-authored, branded flowcharts carrying the branch logic.

plugins.name: herdr-handoff
plugins.description: /handoff-recap writes a handoff doc, then /clears the herdr pane and resumes a fresh session from it in place. Plus a hook that titles herdr tabs after the real topic.
